name: Application shows the Initial and the Merchant-Call Underwriter
description:
Objective: Application shows the Initial and the Merchant-Call Underwriter.
Preconditions: Open Merchant call workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Merchant call workflow.
2. Application shows the Initial and the Merchant-Call Underwriter.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: PRD 6.7: the record must always display both underwriters.
